# PHANTOMX Engineering Contract

- One atomic task at a time.
- Evidence before confidence.
- Verification before integration.
- Integration before optimization.
- Simulation before execution.
- Receipt and independent balance reconciliation before any realized-PnL claim.
- Fail closed on stale, missing, contradictory, or uncertain evidence.
- Never store private keys, seed phrases, credentials, API secrets, or wallet signing material.
- No live capital during MVP bootstrap or while any hard gate is RED.
- Do not treat simulations, quotes, generated calldata, unit tests, or expected PnL as realized profit.
- AI agents may propose actions. Deterministic controls decide. The executor only executes an authorized plan.
- Preserve historical evidence and checkpoint state after every material task.

## Goal
Reach a real, independently reconciled, conservative net positive result while preserving a strict minimum conservative net profit threshold greater than $0.50 and a fail-closed execution model.
